notes:
What's Changed

Features

  • default endpoint and version from package.json release
  • sync version, auto HTML/MD notes, copy updater signature release
  • replace OS toast with custom popup window notifications
  • add severity levels and per-type icons to feed notifications
  • persist window modes, add floating mode, show update progress window
  • notification center page and in-app alert feed ui
  • emit sprint and work-item due events from scheduler notifications
  • font-safe zoom, update check UI, and portfolio link ui
  • add auto-updater endpoint and window hardening updater
  • adaptive responsive layout down to 560px windows shell
  • font zoom slider, profile image, GIF chips, and new settings prefs
  • add alert() and prompt() dialog types to devModal modal
  • persist app preferences in the database settings table prefs
  • expand settings and shared confirmations
  • add focus mode to compact HUD
  • edit vault items in place
  • edit and delete reminders
  • edit active sprint name, goal and dates
  • add send-to-sprint action on inbox items
  • edit, delete and reassign work items
  • implement reminder delivery engine with repeat rules
  • wire preferences into app shell
  • add preferences controls to settings page
  • add persisted app preferences service
  • add autostart plugin for launch-on-login setting
  • turn mini window into full compact app with navbar
  • add shared list filter and sort for compact views
  • render mini window as sticky-note panel with live data
  • add floating mini window mode to app shell
  • add window bounds/mini-mode APIs to window control
  • extract workspace modals into shared component
  • add shared workspace and ui-state services

Bug Fixes

  • allow copy/paste and selection inside form fields hardening
  • restore list search and sort on every list page ui
  • give the notifications nav item its own icon ui
  • deliver OS toasts from the Rust scheduler notifications
  • show saved prefs in dropdowns on reload settings
  • connect all entities via camelCase serde contract and FK schema db
  • persist KDF salt and verifier so unlock survives restarts vault
  • wire relational data end-to-end and make schema extensible db

Improvements

  • convert component and global stylesheets to scss ui
  • store preferences and notification feed in the database prefs
  • wire page components into app shell

Styling

  • tighten floating mode layout and reduce modal corner radius ui

Other Changes

  • bump version
  • make mini log dragable
  • increase image size in mini logo
  • fix inline style sheet problem
  • update release script to fetch env key directly
  • add one-go release build script and store README release
